concurrent_isolation_test.note: each model's request completed in roughly its own solo-request time, confirming independent per-model queues rather than serialization behind one shared queue

honest_finding: SmolLM2-360M-Instruct returns near-empty output (immediate EOS, new_tokens=1) on a raw non-chat-templated prompt, while Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct tolerates the same raw prompt format fine. Not a router bug -- confirmed by testing SmolLM2 directly outside the router. Different instruct models have different sensitivity to chat-template formatting; this repo does not apply per-model chat templates yet.
